Closed as a RECORDED CONSTRAINT, not fixed, following Mark's 2026-09-15 decision that no crate here is intended for crates.io (see persona-5s4b.43). Implemented in e0cb678.

The bead's analysis is correct and still current: persona-grpc/build.rs reads ../proto/spiffe/workload/workload.proto with include root ../proto, both above the package root, and cargo package / cargo vendor / docs.rs all exclude files above it. So persona-grpc builds only from inside this workspace checkout. With publish = false on every crate, the workspace IS the only consumer, and one shared proto/ directory is the honest layout for that.

Rather than leave it implicit, the ceiling and the undo are now a ponytail comment on the INCLUDE constant in build.rs: the fix is 'git mv proto persona-grpc/proto' plus dropping '../' from both constants. Verified that is genuinely one move -- the whole proto tree is a single file, proto/spiffe/workload/workload.proto, and persona-grpc/build.rs is the ONLY reference to it anywhere in the tree (checked across *.rs, *.toml, *.yml and the Makefile).

Reopen if any crate here ever becomes publishable.
